name: 48162-textdecode-gemma4-31b-4gpu
hardware: 4x H100 80GB HBM3 (four GPUs of one a3 node, --gres=gpu:4).
architecture: Gemma4ForConditionalGeneration, the multimodal 31B instruct checkpoint: 60-layer text decoder, sliding and full attention interleaved, plus a vision tower. 62.6 GB in bfloat16, public and ungated. Full detail is in the checkpoint's own config.json.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=128, bounded at 1024 requests, safety_seconds 3600. 128 equals `--max-num-seqs`, so every offered stream is resident and nothing waits on admission.
workload: single-turn, text-only, fixed length in and out: 1024 prompt tokens, 1024 generated tokens, 1024 requests, concurrency 128. One guidellm `synthetic_text` source; the backend sets `ignore_eos`, so every request generates exactly 1024 tokens. No images, audio or video are sent. The engine is driven in-process through guidellm's `vllm_python` backend, not over HTTP.
purpose: A 31B multimodal instruct assistant writing 1024-token text answers for 128 concurrent users on four GPUs.
launch:
# The engine's command line. Anything not listed here is left at the engine's own default,
# including kv-cache-dtype, quantization and enforce-eager.
# No VLLM_* environment override is set.
model: google/gemma-4-31B-it
tensor-parallel-size: 4
max-num-seqs: 128
max-model-len: 8192
# Lowered from the engine default of 0.92 purely as a startup-headroom measure; see
# configs/note.md. Per GPU at TP=4 one resident sequence of 1024+1024 tokens costs
# 50 sliding layers x 1024-token window x 4 KV heads x 256 head_dim x 2(K,V) x 2 B = 200 MiB
# plus 10 global layers x 2048 tokens x 1 KV head x 512 head_dim x 2 x 2 B = 40 MiB, i.e.
# 240 MiB; 128 of them need 30 GiB. Weights are 14.6 GiB per GPU, activations and graphs
# ~4 GiB, so 0.70 x 79.19 = 55.4 GiB still leaves a ~36.8 GiB pool -- about 157 sequences,
# comfortably above the 128 this workload runs at, so the running batch is unchanged.
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.70

error.text: the patched version's own code refuses the attention backend this setup needs on H100 GPUs
